# smart-base-external-schemas

Specifications smart-base depends on and does not hold: the smart-kg ontology (L1 and L2 class vocabulary), pinned by commit.

Part of [SMART Base](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `smart-base-external-schemas`, holding `external-schema`.
